Results.ReviewText: Got this for my birthday and I love it. I use it more than my gas bbq
Results.Title: Awesome BBQ

Results.ReviewText:
Great quality grill and awesome after sale service! 
Extremely satisfied!
Results.Title: The original

Results.ReviewText: I love this grill!  This is my 3rd one since 1982.   They work great and last a long time.  It is worth every penny!
Results.Title: Great Grill!

Results.ReviewText: Haven't used it yet but I've had the exact same before and many other Weber Kettles/Gas/Bullets (my two 14" Smokey Joes being the most used [one in my camper and one at my back door]). They've always been 5 star grills (or 4.9 - wish they didn't rust out so quickly but they do last years).
Results.Title: One of Many

Results.ReviewText: We've always owned Webers. They are by far the most dependable for any kind of BBQ !
Results.Title: Grilling is love

Results.ReviewText: Very easy to set up. Seems well made. Very easy to control heat.
Results.Title: New weber setup

Results.ReviewText: Easy to assemble, I get the foods grilled the way I want. My husband uses the big smoker but I want a grill the easy to use for everyday meals. The Original Weber Kettle Grill is perfect for my needs.
Results.Title: Prefect Grill

Results.ReviewText: The 22 inch kettle is very versatile. You can grill over direct heat you can grill over indirect heat. you can set it up for a smoker. There is all kind of accessory you can add to it. It is just a great all-around barbecue tool.
Results.Title: Weber 22 kettle

Results.ReviewText: Great product, quality and price, my firts weber and i´m in shock with this wonderful thing, i made 4 meals, and everything works fine.
Results.Title: For beginners is excelent

Results.ReviewText: This is my third because I have had them for thirty years. It is basic but I love the versatility. The first one lasted 15 years and still worked when I moved and gave it to a neighbour; the second was stolen after 7 years...  I bought the optional grill that allows adding charcoal at the sides which is more convenient for extended convection cooking or smoking. Great for a true BBQ experience!
Results.Title: Sooo...this is my third 'Original Kettle'

Results.ReviewText: Weber kettle grills are still the most convenient and durable charcoal grills on the market.
Results.Title: Weber Still the Standard

Results.ReviewText: Good quality grill.  I wish I would have bought the one with the thermometer built in, but I'm going to add an aftermarket one.
Results.Title: It's a Weber so it's got to be good

Results.ReviewText: Weber continues to have great products and professional and friendly customer service.
Results.Title: Excellence

Results.ReviewText:
I don’t think at this point this grill needs another review, but why not…
This grill does what the Weber Kettle always has. It’s consistent, easy and just works.
Results.Title: It is exactly what you expect it to be.

Results.ReviewText: It’s a very good grill for the price. It’s perfect for beginners that want to try charcoal!!
Results.Title: Nice grill for the price

Results.ReviewText: Easy to assemble, and works great.  This is a excellent starter grill and if maintained can be used as you progress in your skills
Results.Title: Excellent Grill

Results.ReviewText: Good to see that the legs now lock in.  Need a better hook to hang the lid on the side of the kettle.  I find that it is necessary to hunt to get the lid hanger SAFELY attached to the side of the kettle.  It appears that the lid hook is a bit too short.  I dislike having to make 3 or 4 attempts to hang the lid on the kettle with hot coals in the kettle.
Results.Title: Original 22 Inch Classic Kettle Grill

Results.ReviewText: Managed to use it once. Too hot right now, but it is wonderful! Charcoal tastes so much better than gas!
Results.Title: Kettle Grill

Results.ReviewText: Upgraded to the bigger kettle. Love Weber products.
Results.Title: Upgrade!!

Results.ReviewText: Awesome grill. Cooks great. Finally a grill that cooks everything perfect.
Results.Title: New grill

Results.ReviewText: Fabulous Grill! We love it! Absolute perfection every time!
Results.Title: Original Kettle Charcoal Grill 22"

Results.ReviewText: I've owned several Weber products: A+. But you guys are raping people now at $139 for the base Kettle. The price has been steady at $109 dollars for years...your price increase is not correlative to even the extreme presentation of inflation across the board...you just lost a customer.
Results.Title: Excellent Product

Results.ReviewText: Grill will pay for itself with the saving of charcoal alone. Best temperature control I’ve found. Added a hook to the food grate to hang on the edge of the grill while adding charcoal and lighting charcoal.
Results.Title: Simply awesome grill.

Results.OriginalProductName: Barbecue au charbon Original Kettle 22 po
Results.ReviewText: J'ai le modèle Performer à la maison... Très satisfait! Ça m'en pensait un 2e pour le chalet! C'est le modèle original, mais ça fait la job!
Results.Title: 2e charcoal Weber

Results.ReviewText: Works great and it's very easy to maintain.  I just wish it would have come with a cover as well.
Results.Title: Love it

Results.ReviewText: I love my 22 inch Weber grill. This is the second one I purchase. My last one lasted 12 years.
Results.Title: Love my Weber

Results.ReviewText: Of all charcoal grills we have owned over thirty years this Weber grill is the best because it cooks steak, sausages, vegetables and other items to our likings consistently.  Easy to clean and operate.  We are also thankful for Weber's responsiveness when managing warranty issues.
Results.Title: Best Charcoal Weber Grill

Results.ReviewText: It’s as good now as the one I just got rid of that I purchased in Chicago in 1977.
Results.Title: Webber grill

Results.ReviewText: My first 22” and it was just to have more grilling space than my 18”. I love the added grilling space.
Results.Title: Upgrade

Results.ReviewText: The best simple charcoal grill you can buy. I have several grills and smokers, this was a replacement grill at my fishing getaway. You can grill and smoke on these. If you're looking to start grilling and smoking, this is what you need to do simple outdoor cooking task that looks like you spent hundreds on the equipment.
Results.Title: Original Kettle 22"

Results.ReviewText: Very well made however when hooking the lid on the side of the grill, be careful the hook engages the grill. I have dropped it several times already denting the lid.
Results.Title: Weber 22” charcoal grill

Results.ReviewText: I estimate i bought this grill about 7 years ago and I've used it frequently for grilling and as a smoker the entire time I've owned it. I've kept it under cover occasionally, but mostly not and this grill doesn't even care.  It's as good as the day i bought it after several moves and countless hours.
Results.Title: The perfect standard grill

Results.ReviewText: Nothing works better. Great for cooking everything. Last a life time.
Results.Title: Greatest grill ever made. High quality.

Photos.Caption: Tomahawlk done on weber kettle. Perfection!

Results.ReviewText: Love my grill! I want to cook on it everyday! There is a slight learning curve to cooking with charcoal, but once you get it.......amazing!
Results.Title: Weber kettle = king

Results.ReviewText: The kettle is built right and is the only tool you need. This classic grill is what grilling is all about.
Results.Title: Classic and legendary

Results.ReviewText: Great grill, holds temp steady, can be used as a grill or smoker.
Results.Title: Mmmm

Results.ReviewText:
Another professional tool to have in the toolbox (or on your patio) for the grill master dad. Prefectly complements the propane and pellet grills I already have.
Easy to use, large grilling area, and built tos last.
Results.Title: Professional Tool to Have

Results.ReviewText: Great grill. It holds heat very well and it gives your meat that true BBQ smoky flavor. Great purchase as my second grill.
Results.Title: Provides Hickory flavor.

Results.ReviewText: The best charcoal grill on the market. We have so much grilling with the Weber Grill on the weekends.
Results.Title: The Best Charcoal Grill.

Results.ReviewText: Great grill at a great price. Easy to use and bbqs like a champ. With a little practice and patience it produces amazing smoked meats and excellent searing; whichever is required
Results.Title: Couldn’t be happier

Results.ReviewText: Love cooking on it. Meat and veggies are bomb. I have a charcoal grill and think I would have preferred a propane style.  But I can’t complain about some ash and better taste.
Results.Title: Weber

Results.ReviewText: I'm 44 years old and have never grilled. So when I purchased my first grill it was obviously the classic WEBER kettle. The instruction booklet, BILT app made assembly easy. And the WEBER app and instruction booklet give all the info to learn grilling in an easy to follow manner. If I can do it, anyone can do it!
Results.Title: A Classic Grilling Staple

Results.ReviewText: Aways been very happy with Weber grills Gas or charcoal.
Results.Title: Weber make grilling fun!!!

Results.ReviewText: We've always loved this Weber grill. The new one replaces the old and is appreciated as much.
Results.Title: The Weber charcoal grill is perfect for us!

Results.ReviewText: So far I am really enjoying my grill.  It is exactly what I wanted!  I bought my parents a Weber charcoal grill like this decades ago.  And they used it for decades.  I hope mine lasts like their did.  Very easy to use and clean up is easy, too.  I bought mine at Ace Hardware in Oviedo, Fl near UCF.  The employees there couldn't have been nicer or more helpful.
Results.Title: Exactly what I wanted!

Results.ReviewText:
Bringing back childhood tastes and flavors and
Memories from grilling with charcoal again! Passing it on to my boys now! Man it tastes so good!
Results.Title: Childhood Memories reborn!

741001.Name: Original Kettle Charcoal Grill 22"
741001.Description: Stay true to the modern version of the kettle that started it all—the Original Kettle®, invented by Weber’s founder, and loved around the world. Its ultra-durable, porcelain-enameled lid and bowl retain heat, while the dampers easily adjust for precise temperature control. With a One-Touch™ cleaning system for easy cleanup after a long day of grilling, the Original Kettle® will always be the grill built for everyone.•	 Holds up to 13 burgers made with a Weber burger press•	 One-Touch™ cleaning system provides hassle-free ash cleanup•	 Porcelain-enameled lid and bowl retain heat, and won’t rust or peel•	 Use the lid hook to avoid placing the lid on the ground while grilling•	 Dampers allow you to easily control the temperature inside your grill•	 Durable plated steel cooking grate retains heat and is easy to clean
